name: Reddit
description: Subreddits like r/SideProject, r/startups, r/SaaS, and r/Entrepreneur each have distinct audiences. Share genuinely, not promotionally.

name: SourceForge
description: One of the oldest and largest software directories. Especially strong for open-source and developer tools.

name: G2
description: Enterprise-focused review platform. Millions of B2B buyers use G2 to evaluate software before purchasing.

name: Capterra
description: Software directory owned by Gartner. Strong SEO presence means your listing gets found organically.

name: Hacker News
description: Tech-focused community. A Show HN post that resonates can drive thousands of developer visits in hours.

name: SaaSHub
description: Independent software marketplace with alternatives, reviews, and trending products.

name: Fazier
description: Startup launch platform with an engaged community of early adopters.

name: AlternativeTo
description: Crowdsourced software recommendations. Users search for tools by comparing them to ones they already know.

name: Uneed
description: Curated tool directory with daily rankings. Paid options get you featured faster.

name: Indie Hackers
description: Founders sharing revenue numbers, growth strategies, and hard-won lessons. The audience is other builders who give honest, technical feedback.

name: SaaSworthy
description: SaaS discovery platform with awards, ratings, and comparison features.

name: There's An AI For That
description: The largest AI tool directory, updated daily. High traffic from people actively searching for AI solutions.

name: Peerlist
description: Professional network for builders with integrated launch features and peer endorsements.

name: BetaList
description: Curated startup directory focused on early-stage products. Paid options for faster listing.

name: SideProjectors
description: Marketplace for side projects. Launch, get feedback, or even sell your project.

name: OpenHunts
description: Open-source alternative to Product Hunt. Community-driven with transparent ranking.

name: Toolfio
description: Software directory great for SaaS. Free listing requires adding their badge to your site. Paid option removes the badge requirement.

name: Web Review
description: SEO directory that gives you 3 permanent dofollow backlinks. Helps boost domain authority and visibility on Google, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

name: MicroLaunch
description: Built specifically for indie hackers and micro-SaaS. Smaller audience, but highly relevant.

name: DevHunt
description: Launch platform exclusively for developer tools. If your audience is developers, start here.

name: Firsto
description: Minimalist launch platform designed to help you find your very first users.

name: Future Tools
description: Curated and searchable AI tool collection. Strong YouTube and newsletter audience drives extra visibility.

name: Launching Next
description: Submit your startup to get listed and discovered by early adopters browsing new products.

name: StartupStash
description: Curated directory of resources and tools organized by category. Good for reaching startup founders.

name: TinyLaunchpad
description: Lightweight launch platform for small products, side projects, and experiments.

name: BetaPage
description: Community of beta testers actively looking for new products to try and review.

name: Resource.fyi
description: Curated collection of tools and resources for designers and developers.
